info.title: H18ABANANA Sprint 1 API Contract
info.description: Proposed implementation contract, not an implemented service or team-approved agreement. Based on Sprint 1 US-01..US-09, the 2026-09-30 client minutes and current Jira subtasks. See sprint-1-api-contract.md for assumptions and workflows. JSON field names use camelCase; timestamps use UTC RFC3339; role/status enum values are uppercase. US-01 supplement adds verified-email registration and email/account-ID login.

post.summary: Upload a PDF or DOCX and start extraction
post.description: Proposed limit 10 MiB. Accept PDF/DOCX, reject legacy .doc. Validate server-side content and size, not only extension. Return QUEUED immediately; extraction runs separately. Status polling does not imply a particular queue framework. Do not auto-import or confirm. Manual entry remains available.

get.description: QUEUED -> PROCESSING -> READY or FAILED. Poll every 2 seconds while the view is open; stop on a terminal state and pause after 60 seconds with a manual refresh option. FAILED has a safe error; other states have error=null.
READY -> 200; QUEUED/PROCESSING -> 409 EXTRACTION_NOT_READY; FAILED -> 422 EXTRACTION_FAILED. Suggestions never alter the current profile.

get.summary: List matching talent for a team-owned opportunity
get.description: Published opportunity owner only. Exclude opted-out or currently unconfirmed profiles before calculating total, rank or scores. Evaluate using only visible fields; hidden fields are treated like missing evidence. Order score descending, unknownWeightPercent ascending, talentId ascending; null scores last. rank is global. Empty visible fields are allowed and produce Unknown; never leak hidden names/email/files. An unpublished opportunity returns 404 on this route, including to its owner. An unpublished opportunity returns 404 on this route, including to its owner. US-14: q searches only permitted fields and interest labels/text. Unknown parameters return 422. Current consent/confirmation/visibility are applied before filtering, scoring, totals and ranks.

post.description: Send a six-digit registration code through SMTP. Requires an anonymous session, CSRF token and allowed Origin. Code is session-bound, single-use, expires after 10 minutes; resend interval 60 seconds; 5 emails per email and 20 per connecting IP per hour. No code appears in API responses or logs.

Verify the latest six-digit code and create a TALENT or RESEARCH_TEAM account. Requires the same anonymous session that requested the code. Five verification attempts per code. Creates a unique account ID and rotates into an authenticated session; talent profile/privacy defaults are created atomically. Existing email addresses return 409.

201.description: Account created and signed in. user.id is the assigned login ID.

Set-Cookie.description: Host-only h18_session cookie; HttpOnly; Secure on HTTPS; SameSite=Lax; Path=/. Never expose its value in JSON.

post.summary: Send a password reset email code
post.description: Send a six-digit password reset code to an active registered email. Unknown/inactive emails receive the same 202 shape without an email. Requires session/CSRF/Origin; code expires in 10 minutes, 60-second cooldown, 5 requests per email and 20 per IP per hour. Registration codes cannot be used here.

202.description: Send a six-digit password reset code to an active registered email.

post.summary: Verify an email before choosing a new password
post.description: Verify the latest code in its requesting session and authorize one password reset until expiresAt. Five attempts per code; hashes and limits persist across restarts. The code cannot be verified again or used in another session.

200.description: Verify the latest code in its requesting session and authorize one password reset until expiresAt.

post.summary: Reset a password using credentials or verified email
post.description: Set a new password containing at least one uppercase letter, lowercase letter and digit, with 8–200 characters. New and confirmation passwords must match; new password must differ from current password. PASSWORD verifies identifier/currentPassword; EMAIL_CODE requires prior verification in the same session. Atomically update the hash, invalidate all account sessions and reset codes, and return a fresh anonymous Session. Sign in again using the new password. A signed-in caller can only reset their own account. Concurrent credential changes return 409 PASSWORD_RESET_INVALID.

200.description: Set a new password containing at least one uppercase letter, lowercase letter and digit, with 8–200 characters.

ProfileContent.description: Canonical owner profile: eight legacy fields plus optional-compatible researchInterestText, customInterestTags and owner-only resumeDescription, returned with empty defaults for old profiles.

researchInterestText.description: Source-grounded research-interest description. Optional on writes: omitted preserves stored text; empty string clears it. Shares researchInterests visibility.

customInterestTags.description: Accepted owner-local interest labels. New items omit id. Exact shared labels resolve to shared IDs; omission preserves the selection and [] clears it. Shared/personal combined maximum is 100.

resumeDescription.description: Unified owner-only description retaining readable source text from the whole resume, including unmatched sections. Optional writes preserve it when omitted; empty string clears it. Never shared with teams or used as unrestricted matching evidence.

ProfileSections.description: Replace only submitted sections/components, including owner-only resumeDescription. Omitted components and their provenance persist; empty strings clear text and [] clears selections. Accepted exact shared labels append canonical shared IDs.

Confirmation.description: Prototype choice: confirm the entire current profile revision. Any actual content change invalidates confirmation for the whole profile. Privacy changes are separate.

FieldOrigin.description: Owner-only provenance set by the server. USER_REVIEWED_DOCUMENT records a review/import workflow, not independent verification of document contents.

researchInterestText.description: Source-grounded research-interest description. Optional on writes: omitted preserves stored text; empty string clears it. Shares researchInterests visibility.

customInterestTags.description: Unaccepted, source-grounded personal interest label proposals. Extraction creates no persistent labels; the owner can accept/edit/reject them through the reviewed apply endpoint.

resumeDescription.description: Unified owner-only description retaining readable source text from the whole resume, including unmatched sections. Optional writes preserve it when omitted; empty string clears it. Never shared with teams or used as unrestricted matching evidence.

Extraction.description: Owner-only source-grounded suggestions with free-text skill titles/evidence, shared interest IDs, interest free text and personal-label proposals. Suggestions never create tags, update or confirm profiles.

ApplyExtractionRequest.description: User-reviewed values, possibly corrected, to import from an owner-owned READY document. Replaces only named sections, increments profile revision and marks the whole profile UNCONFIRMED. Does not confirm or match automatically.

Requirement.description: SKILL requirements use skillTitles or legacy skill tags. INTEREST requirements use shared interest tags. Academic requirements use non-empty structured criteria and empty tagIds.

opportunityType.description: Optional type; omission preserves the stored value on update, null clears it.

deadlineAt.description: Optional RFC3339 deadline with explicit offset, at most microsecond precision. UTC on reads; omission preserves on update, null clears it. Omitted on reads when unset.

sourceUrl.description: Optional absolute HTTP/HTTPS source URL. Omission preserves it on update; null removes it. Omitted on reads when unset. Links are never fetched, imported or used as matching evidence.

availabilityStatus.description: Current UTC availability. Present on live responses; optional for legacy fixtures/clients.

reopen.description: Explicitly reopen a published opportunity with a future or null deadline; applies atomically with content.

recordId.description: Skill record ID for skills; shared tag ID for interests. Never substitute a skill criterion tag ID for the actual skill record.
Skill record ID for skills; shared tag ID for interests. Never substitute a skill criterion tag ID for the actual skill record.

TeamEvidence.description: Redacted shape: no document IDs, raw filenames, download URLs, raw extraction text or hidden fields.

recommendationScore.description: Ranking score: 70% structured score + 30% unrounded semantic percentage by default. Configurable semantic weight [0,1]; use semantic percentage alone when structured score is null; fallback to structured score when semantic input/model is unavailable. Rounded HALF_UP to two decimals.

MatchSummary.description: Draft scoring: REQUIRED weight 2, PREFERRED 1; MATCHED=1, PARTIAL=.5, GAP/UNKNOWN=0. Score is evidence coverage, not a probability. No criteria -> null score and null unknown percentage. Application semantic matching adds recommendationScore, rankingAlgorithmVersion and semanticInterest. score and algorithmVersion still describe structured evidence coverage. New fields are omitted when semantic matching is disabled. Lists sort by recommendationScore when present, then lower unknown weight, then stable ID; filters and privacy apply before inference and pagination.

researchInterestText.description: Source-grounded research-interest description. Optional on writes: omitted preserves stored text; empty string clears it. Shares researchInterests visibility.

VisibleProfile.description: Only confirmed permitted content. researchInterests visibility covers shared IDs, researchInterestText and customInterestTags together. Omit all three if hidden. No original documents or provenance.

RegistrationRequest.description: A verified email can create either supported account role. Passwords are chosen by the user and stored only as Argon2id hashes.

NewPassword.description: At least 8 characters, including an ASCII uppercase letter, lowercase letter and digit; maximum 200 characters.

identifier.description: Account email or server-assigned user.id. IDs are case-sensitive.

PasswordResetRequest.description: PASSWORD: verify current credentials. EMAIL_CODE: first verify a mailed code in the same session. Both require matching newPassword/confirmPassword and a new password distinct from the current password.

researchInterestText.description: Source-grounded research-interest description. Optional on writes: omitted preserves stored text; empty string clears it. Shares researchInterests visibility.

customInterestTags.description: Accepted owner-local interest labels. New items omit id. Exact shared labels resolve to shared IDs; omission preserves the selection and [] clears it. Shared/personal combined maximum is 100.

resumeDescription.description: Unified owner-only description retaining readable source text from the whole resume, including unmatched sections. Optional writes preserve it when omitted; empty string clears it. Never shared with teams or used as unrestricted matching evidence.

ProfileContentWrite.description: Replace the eight legacy fields; optional researchInterestText, customInterestTags and resumeDescription preserve stored values when omitted. Expected revision is mandatory; real changes invalidate confirmation.

Skill.description: A free-text skill title and supporting evidence. No vocabulary tag or claim selector. ID identifies the profile record, not a shared tag. Explicit legacy negative statements retain their wording when upgraded.

SemanticInterest.description: Local cosine similarity over current permitted research interest text/shared/personal labels and opportunity research area/INTEREST labels. score=max(0,similarity)*100, rounded to two decimals. relevance thresholds: PARTIAL >=0.45; RELEVANT >=0.75. Missing input or unavailable model yields null similarity/score, UNKNOWN relevance, weight zero. No qualification or requirement status is inferred from similarity.

Csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
Csrf.description: Value returned by GET /auth/session (or login). Required for every mutation, including multipart upload and login. Validate Origin as well. Registration and code requests also require this token.

400.description: Malformed JSON or invalid request framing.

401.description: Authentication is missing/expired, or credentials are invalid.

404.description: Resource does not exist or is inaccessible to this user.

409.description: Revision conflict, unconfirmed profile, or extraction not ready. Also used when the registration email already exists or a code request was superseded.

413.description: File exceeds the proposed 10 MiB limit.

415.description: Unsupported request media type, or unsupported uploaded file type.

422.description: Field validation failed, extraction failed, or publish/confirm preconditions failed.

500.description: Unexpected server error; do not return internal details.

503.description: Registration email could not be delivered. No account is created.

SessionCookie.name: h18_session
SessionCookie.description: Opaque server-side session. HTTPS cookie: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, host-only. All mutations additionally require X-CSRF-Token and an allowed Origin. Use a same-origin development proxy.
